scientific_integrity: Analytical proof provided, supported by 2210 exact-rational reproducibility cases. Independent audit has not been performed. No originality claim for general Gramian submodularity, modular trace, or qualitative uniform leader spreading.
scientific_limitations: Only two distinct unit coordinate input channels on a damped cyclic permutation, n≥3, r∈(0,1), and horizons equal to positive multiples of n or infinity. General arbitrary horizons, actuator weights, and symmetric Laplacians not covered. Qualitative even spacing of leaders in directed ring models is established prior art; historical exact equivalents remain a risk.
title: Simultaneous four-criterion optimal placement of two actuators on a damped directed ring
